title: FOLLOW THIS POWERFUL 7-DAY PRAYER GUIDE AND WATCH YOUR LIFE CHANGE
text: Glory to God. Glory to God. Somebody say glory. I want you to settle in your spirit right now because what is about [music] to happen in this place, what is about to happen as you engage with this word is not ordinary. This is not a motivational session. This is not a self-help seminar. This is a portal. [music] This is a dispensary of divine reality and the Holy Spirit himself has authorized this moment. I want you to know that before you came here, before you open this, before your eyes fell on these words, God had already arranged this encounter. [music] He does not waste your time. He does not bring you to a table and serve you nothing. Every time God calls you to a place of engagement, he has already loaded that atmosphere with what you need. So, receive it. Open your spirit. Say, "Lord, I receive." Now, I want to talk to you today and over these 7 days, I want to walk with you through a dimension of prayer that will not leave you the same. I want to talk to you about the 7-day prayer guide and I want you to understand before we even begin. Prayer is not begging. [music] Prayer is not an emergency hotline you call when things go wrong. Prayer is a lifestyle. Prayer is a jurisdiction. Prayer is the place where heaven and earth negotiate [music] and you are the ambassador standing in the gap. The Bible says in Isaiah 59:16 that he saw that there was no man and wondered that there was no intercessor. God was not wondering because he [music] was confused. He was wondering because he was looking for a human vessel to legitimize heavenly intervention on earth. You see? God set up a system. Heaven is his throne. Earth is his footstool, [music] but he gave the earth to the children of men. Psalm 115:16. [music] He did not take it back. He gave it. And that means for heaven to move legally, consistently, and sustainably on earth, somebody with an earthly address has to open the door. Somebody has to pray. [music] You are that somebody. Before we go further, I want you to do something right now. I want you to share this prayer guide. Share it [music] with someone. Share it with a friend, a family member, somebody who needs a breakthrough, somebody whose fire has gone cold, somebody who has been waiting and wondering if God still hears. Share it because what God is doing in these 7 days is not just for you alone. The anointing on this is transferable. The grace on this is spreadable. When you share something kingdom, you don't lose your portion, you multiply it. The woman with the oil, every vessel she found, the oil kept flowing. When you stop finding vessels, the oil stops. So, find a vessel. Share this. Let someone else encounter God through this portal that God has opened. Do it now and come back because the best is still ahead. Now, let us begin. Let us begin with the understanding that prayer is a science before it is an [music] art. There are principles that govern prayer. There are laws, and many believers are frustrated not because God does not hear, [music] but because they are violating kingdom protocols and expecting kingdom results. The Bible says in Hosea 4:2-6, "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge, [music] not lack of anointing, not lack of sincerity, not lack of passion, lack of knowledge." You can be sincere and be sincerely wrong. You can pray passionately and pray amiss. James 4:2-3 [music] says, "You ask and receive not because you ask amiss." So, there is a way to ask. There is a dimension of asking that guarantees receiving, and that is what we are stepping into over these 7 days. Day one, and I want you to follow me carefully. Day one is the day of foundations. [music] Before you build anything, you must deal with what is underneath. The reason many prayer altars [music] collapse is because they are not built on solid ground. Jesus said in Matthew 7:24 that the wise man built his house upon the [music] rock. When the floods came, when the wind blew, when the storms descended, the house stood because the foundation was right. What is the foundation of prayer? It is relationship. It is not [music] religion. Religion is a routine. Relationship is a reality. Before you can move mountains with your words, you must first be in alignment with the mountain mover. Before you can declare things and they shall be established, [music] Job 22:28, you must first be established in him. David said in Psalm 27:3-4, "One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after, that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord and to inquire in his temple." David was not primarily asking for victory. He was not primarily asking for his enemies to be scattered. He was [music] asking for proximity. He was asking for nearness. And it is [music] from that place of nearness that everything else becomes accessible. So, on day one, your prayer is not a long list of [music] requests. On day one, your prayer is a consecration prayer. You are saying, "Lord, I consecrate this week to you. I consecrate my mouth. I consecrate my heart. I consecrate my time. I consecrate my attention. Search me, oh God, and know my heart, Psalm 139:1-23. Try me and know my thoughts. See if there be any wicked way in me." You are doing a spiritual audit. You are asking the Holy Spirit to identify anything in you that would hinder the flow of prayer over these 7 days. Unforgiveness, the number one prayer blocker. Mark 11:25 says, "When you stand praying, forgive. If you have anything against any man that your Father also, which is in heaven, may forgive you your trespasses." The same verse that tells you to believe you receive is the same verse that commands you to forgive. Jesus put them in the same passage deliberately. Unforgiveness and faith cannot coexist in the same heart and produce kingdom results. So, on day one, you forgive, you release. Not because they deserve [music] it, not because it does not hurt, but because your prayer life is more valuable than your offense. Your destiny is more important than your pain. You choose forgiveness as [music] a strategic kingdom decision. Father, on behalf of every person engaging with this word right now, I decree that the foundations of their prayer life are being strengthened. Every crack in the foundation [music] healed. Every compromise in the altar purged by the blood of Jesus. Holy Spirit, I ask you to come as the spirit of grace and supplications that Zechariah 12:10 speaks of. Come and awaken a hunger for prayer in every [music] heart. Come and break the spirit of prayerlessness. Come and dismantle every excuse. Let there be a supernatural draw to the place of prayer in Jesus' name. I declare day one is established in the name of Jesus. Now, let me move you into day two. Day two is the day of Thanksgiving and prophetic praise. I want you to understand the theology of praise before you engage in it because many people [music] praise without understanding what they are doing. Praise is not flattery. Praise is not an emotional exercise. Praise is a weapon. Psalm 149:2-6 says, "Let the high praises of God be in their mouth and a two-edged sword in their hand." The praise and [music] the sword are in the same verse. Why? Because when you praise, you are not just expressing gratitude, [music] you are executing judgment. You are releasing a spiritual force that dismantles demonic strongholds. 2 Chronicles 20, Jehoshaphat faced an army too large for him to fight. God told him, "This battle is not yours, but mine." And the strategy God gave him was not military, it was musical. He sent the singers ahead of the army, and when they began to sing, when they began to praise, the enemies turned on themselves and destroyed one another. The battle was won before a single sword was drawn in the natural. That is what praise does. Praise creates a supernatural environment where [music] your enemies fight each other. On day two, you enter the gates [music] with Thanksgiving and the courts with praise. Psalm 100 to 4. You begin by rehearsing the goodness of God. You begin by calling out specific things he has done, not [music] what you want him to do, what he has done. You remind yourself of the testimonies. You remind yourself of the times he showed up when no one else could. You remind yourself of healings, of provisions, of divine [music] interventions, of doors that opened against all natural odds. When you rehearse what he has done, faith rises. When faith rises, you can ask for the impossible [music] and not stagger. Abraham staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief, but was strong [music] in faith. Romans 4:20. Giving glory to God. Giving glory. Praise was the fuel that kept Abraham's faith strong over 25 years of waiting. So, on day two, you praise your way into a place of faith that makes your request audible to heaven. I want to pray over you right now. Father, I thank you for every person reading this. I thank you because you have been faithful. You have been consistent. [music] You have been the God who does not lie, the God whose word does not return void. I thank you for the testimonies that have already been written in their lives. You are Jehovah Rapha, [music] the Lord who heals. You are Jehovah Nissi, the Lord our banner. You are the [music] God of the breakthrough, the God of the suddenly, the God who turns midnight into morning. I praise you. And in this atmosphere of praise, I declare that every chain is broken, every yoke is destroyed. Isaiah 10:27 says the yoke shall be destroyed because of the [music] anointing. As we praise, the anointing flows. As the anointing flows, the yokes are destroyed in Jesus' mighty name. Amen. Day three. Day three is the day of the word. John 15:2-7 is one of the most powerful verses on prayer in the entire scripture. Jesus said, "If you abide in me and my words abide in you, [music] you shall ask what you will and it shall be done unto you." There is a condition before the promise. Abiding the words abiding in you. This is the principle of word-saturated prayer. When you pray the word, you are not praying [music] your own opinion. You are not praying your feelings. You are praying the eternal, immutable, unchangeable will of God and the will of God [music] cannot be denied. Isaiah 55:10-11, "My word shall not return unto me void, but shall accomplish that which I please." When you take a scripture and [music] you pray it back to God, you are essentially loading a divine bullet into a divine gun and pulling the trigger. The target [music] cannot resist it because the word itself carries the power of the one who spoke it. On day three, you are going to choose scriptures. You are going to choose scriptures that speak to your specific situation. If it is financial, Philippians 4:19, "My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory." [music] Pray that. Personalize it. Say, "Father, your word says you shall supply [music] all my need, not some of my need, all of it. Not according to the economy of my country, not according to the salary they are paying me, but according to your riches in glory by Christ Jesus. I stand on this word. [music] I enforce this word. If it is healing, Isaiah 53:2-5, by his stripes I am healed. Not I will be healed. I am healed. It is past tense in the original because it was settled at the cross. You are not asking [music] God to heal you as if it has not been provided. You are enforcing a provision that already exists. There is a difference between petition and enforcement. Petition says, "God, please do this." Enforcement says, "Father, your word says this is already done. I stand on the finished work. I enforce it in Jesus' name." This is why the believer's prayer is different from the prayer of a sinner trying to get God's attention. You are not trying to get God's attention. You have his attention. He knows your name. He has numbered the hairs on your head. He has written your days in his book before one of them came to pass. Psalm 139:16. You are not [music] a stranger to God. You are a son. You are a daughter. And sons and daughters do not beg. They receive. They stand on the inheritance. They enforce the covenant. Prophetically, I want to declare over you right now. I hear the spirit of God saying that there are those engaging with this prayer guide who have been praying for something for a long time. Yes. And you have begun to wonder if the answer is coming. [music] The enemy has whispered to you that maybe this is not God's will. Maybe your faith is not enough. Maybe something is wrong with you. I want to prophetically dismantle that lie right now. The Bible says in 2 Corinthians 1:20 that all the promises of God [music] in him are yea and in him amen onto the glory of God by us. All, not some. Not the convenient ones. Not the ones that are easy to believe. All. And they are yea yes. They are not maybe. They are not contingent on your emotional state. They are yea and amen. So, whatever you have been believing God for, I declare today is a turning point. The delay is not denial, the silence is not abandonment, God is faithful and he will do it. He will do it. In the name of Jesus. Day four, day four takes us into the dimension of [music] spiritual warfare and intercession. And I need to be very careful here because there is a generation of believers [music] who are fighting the wrong enemy. Ephesians 6:12 is a verse that every praying Christian must tattoo on the inside of their spirit. We wrestle not, I said we wrestle not against flesh and blood. Your husband [music] is not your enemy. Your boss is not your enemy, the government is not your enemy, the person who betrayed you is not your enemy. There is a devil, there are principalities, there are powers, there are rulers of the darkness of this [music] world. There are spiritual wickedness in high places. What is a stronghold? A stronghold is a thought pattern, a belief system, a spiritual structure that exalts itself against the knowledge of God. And prayer targeted, specific, scripturally grounded prayer [music] is what pulls it down. Communing is a dialogue. Many believers pray but never listen. They come to God with a list, they read the list, they say amen, and they leave, and they wonder why they don't hear from God.
